PAYMENTS EXPANSION | G2-G6 | Availability, adoption, penetration
|
|-- Availability: rollout milestones
|   |-- [S] 2019: 15 countries; 2022: 22 countries.
|   |-- [S] End-2024: 23; Q1 2025: +16 = 39 countries.
|   |-- [S] Additions: 15 European countries plus Mexico.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: UAE launch brings total to 40.
|   `-- Country reconciliation -[contra]-> [X] "60 new countries".
|       [I] Sixteen/sixty transcription error is plausible, unconfirmed.
|
|-- Availability -[mech]-> ability to monetize payments locally
|   |-- [I] Enabled payments still require merchant adoption and volume.
|   |-- [S] 2019: limited merchant solutions meant lower initial take rate.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2025: multi-entity Payments support launched.
|
|-- Adoption and penetration measure different things
|   |-- [R] EMEA merchant adoption: 86% 2024 -> 83% 2025.
|   |-- [R] Filing attributes adoption decline to market expansion.
|   |-- [S] Q1 2026: new European markets weigh on global penetration.
|   |-- [S] Q2 2026: global GMV penetration 68%, +3 points YoY.
|   `-- [S] Q2 2026: Europe penetration increased >350 bp YoY.
|
`-- Availability -[assoc]-> international GMV; attribution remains open
    |-- [S] Q1 2024: Europe's third straight quarter above 35% GMV growth.
    |-- [I] Strong growth preceded the large 2025 country rollout.
    |-- [I] Launches may follow traction as well as support it.
    `-- [S] Q3 2026: management says local payments aided European growth.
        Local payments -[claim]-> additional growth; no controlled test.
